name: engineering-loop
description: Coordinated engineering workflows: engineering-loop takes a new capability from requirements, design, independent critique, and approval to a pull request, issue-resolution takes a reproducible defect from evidence to root cause, an approved fix plan, and a runtime-validated pull request, and pr-review reviews a GitHub or Azure DevOps pull request across security, design, canonical practice, and performance, then posts only the exact comment set the user approved. Engineering-loop and issue-resolution are visualized live as multi-session pipelines.
